entities.summary: Brandon David Reed is an American former professional football player who was a wide receiver in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Utah Utes and was selected by the Baltimore Ravens in the fifth round of the 2010 NFL draft. With the Ravens he won Super Bowl XLVII, and he also played a season with the Indianapolis Colts.
